deceptive_framing.quote: H2 is the only condition involving deception, it is optional, narrowly scoped, individually reviewed, and always paired with a debrief.

hypothetical_framing.quote: make the stakes genuinely real so no lie is told

actually_commit_money.quote: The most robust way to make a model believe the stakes are real is for them to be real.

debrief.quote: append a debrief to the transcript record stating the true study context, what was real, and what was withheld.
